name: Papelería Naranjita
description: Stationery store in Colonia Nicolich, Canelones, with a WooCommerce shop for pens, notebooks, school items, crafts, planners, backpacks and geometry supplies. States shipping across Uruguay and has a local at Arenas Shopping.
description_es: Papelería de Colonia Nicolich, Canelones, con tienda en WooCommerce de escritura, cuadernos, artículos escolares, manualidades, agendas, mochilas y geometría. Indica envíos a todo Uruguay y tiene un local en Arenas Shopping.

ships_to.notes: States shipping anywhere in Uruguay; costs and delivery times not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Two stores are listed, but the pages do not say whether online orders can be collected.

shopping_notes: Payment via Mercado Pago in installments is stated at checkout.

sources.supports: ships anywhere in Uruguay, two store locations
